items.title: back east 的地域方向误用
items.explanation: back east 通常指美国东部，不能用来描述从纽约前往位于美国西部的洛杉矶；该语境应使用 travel west 或直接说 travel to Los Angeles。
items.source: She lives in New York and travels to Los Angeles back east every summer.
items.example: She lives in New York and travels west to Los Angeles every summer.

items.title: but 后并列分句需要谓语动词
items.explanation: but 连接两个完整分句时，后半句需要有限谓语；不能只写 but living，应写 but they later settled 或 but now live。
items.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
items.example: My grandparents came from back east, but they later settled in Arizona.

items.title: 以前住在某地要用过去表达
items.explanation: 中文“以前/过去住在某地”强调过去状态，英语通常用 lived in 或 used to live in；不要用一般现在时 live in 表示过去居住。
items.source: My parents live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.
items.example: My parents used to live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.

items.title: 洛杉矶的英文地名表达
items.explanation: 中文地名“洛杉矶”在英语中应使用标准英文名 Los Angeles，不能按汉语拼音写成 luoshanji；专有名词的两个单词都要大写。
items.source: She works in luoshanji, but she visits her parents back east every year.
items.example: She works in Los Angeles, but she visits her parents back east every year.

items.title: located 作表语时不要漏掉 be 动词
items.explanation: located 是过去分词；表示某地或某机构位于某处时，通常使用 be located in/at，不能直接写主语加 located。
items.source: The company's headquarters located in Chicago, but it has several offices back east.
items.example: The company's headquarters is located in Chicago.

items.title: 误把 go out with someone 理解为字面外出
items.explanation: 在恋爱或嫉妒等语境中，go out with someone 通常表示和某人约会或谈恋爱，不能按字面理解为和某人出去或从某处出去。
items.source: 1. A; 2. 不是，表示从她办公室出去了
items.example: Tom got jealous because Lisa was going out with someone from her office.

items.title: grandparents 的复数对应
items.explanation: 中文“祖父母”通常对应复数 grandparents；描述两位祖辈时不能使用单数 grandparent。
items.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
items.example: My grandparents came from back east.

items.title: 用定语从句或现在分词修饰 friend
items.explanation: 修饰 a friend 时，不能直接说 a friend lived near；应使用定语从句 a friend who lives nearby，或现在分词短语 a friend living nearby。
items.source: I am waiting for a friend lived near.
items.example: I am waiting for a friend who lives nearby.

items.title: several 后接可数名词复数
items.explanation: several 表示“几个”，后面接可数名词复数；因此应说 several offices，而不是 several office。
items.source: The company has several office in the east, but the head is in Chigaco.
items.example: The company has several offices in the East.
